name: Baratza Encore ESP
details: Electric conical burr grinder with a finer espresso range.

grindRanges.scale: settings 1–40: 1–20 is the fine-step espresso range, 21–40 the filter range

notes.turkish: Not fine enough for Turkish coffee.

rangeInfo.note: Baratza Encore ESP operations manual (v1.0), “Recommended initial grind settings”: espresso range 1–20 (start at 15 for 18 g of a medium roast), filter range 21–40; suggested settings AeroPress 22, Hario V60 25, automatic brewer 28, Chemex 30, French press 32.
rangeInfo.estimateNote: Estimated by extrapolating the cited ranges, not from the source: moka pot: 18–21, between espresso and AeroPress; AeroPress: 21–23 around Baratza's 22; pour-over: 24–27 around Baratza's V60 25 (Chemex 30 is coarser); drip coffee maker: 27–29 around Baratza's automatic brewer 28; French press: 31–34 around Baratza's 32; cold brew: 34–40, the coarse end of the filter range; Rapid Brewer: from the middle of the AeroPress range to the middle of the pour-over range. Dial in from there.
